Which $$g{\left(	hetaight)}$$ is best for feature selection (i.e., eliminating irrelevant features and keeping useful ones)? Note: $$p$$ is the total number of parameters in $$	heta.$$

• $$g(	heta)=\sum_{i=1}**{p}\log(	heta_i)$$
• $$g(	heta)=\sum_{i=1}**{p}	heta_i$$
• $$g(	heta)=\sum_{i=1}**{p}|	heta_i|$$
• $$g(	heta)=\sum_{i=1}**{p}	heta_i**{2}$$
